issues.title: Shift Lock Slot Is BEHIND the Selector — Not at Base
issues.detail: This is one of the most commonly misidentified shift lock locations in the field. The override slot on the Camry is located BEHIND the gear selector (toward the rear of the car), NOT at the front or side of the selector base. The slot is vertical — insert the key vertically, not at an angle. Many operators probe the wrong area and conclude the override isn't working.

shiftLock.slot: Small square plastic cover located BEHIND the gear selector (toward the REAR of the center console, NOT at the front base). Look at the console surface just behind where the shifter sits.
steps: Turn ignition to ON (do not start the engine).
Locate the shift lock release in the storage compartment behind the center console — lift the rubber mat to expose the slot.
Insert the ignition key VERTICALLY into the slot beside the cover and pry it upward, OR use a small flathead.
Insert key or thin flathead into the exposed slot and press FIRMLY DOWNWARD.
While holding the slot, press the brake pedal firmly.
Move the selector from Park to Neutral.
Remove tool and replace cover.
Apply parking brake and chock wheels.
Connect jump pack to battery — under the hood.
Once 12V power is restored, press brake and shift to Neutral normally.
